title: Responsible AI Use in Coursework
description: CAT 100 textbook section connecting responsible ai use in coursework to responsible AI use disclosure note, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.
learning_objectives: Read an assignment's AI policy and sort each planned action into allowed, required, or prohibited.
Write an AI-use disclosure that names the tool, the step, and the suggestions you rejected.
Recognize the line between AI assisting your thinking and AI replacing your thinking.
Keep private data (yours and others') out of tools that may store or train on inputs.
